scripts.dev:web: cd mobile && cross-env EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:4000/api npx expo start --web --clear
scripts.dev:iphone:only: node -e "const os=require('os');const ip=Object.values(os.networkInterfaces()).flat().find(i=>i.family==='IPv4'&&!i.internal)?.address||'192.168.1.12';process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL='http://'+ip+':4000/api';" && cd mobile && npx expo start --clear
